newsitem.title: CANADA: Kingsway Financial plans issue, split.
newsitem.headline: Kingsway Financial plans issue, split.

text.p: Kingsway Financial Services Inc said on Tuesday it signed an agreement with underwriters for a public offering of C$30 million worth of common shares.
This offering will be accompanied by a concurrent secondary issue of up to C$6 million by Intercargo Corp, Kingsway's largest shareholder.
Kingsway said proceeds will be used to increase the regulatory capital for some of its insurance operations, for working capital and for future strategic acquisitions.
The company also said its board passed a resolution to subdivide the company's stock on a two-for-one basis.
